channel.description: Recent content in Exhibitions on Blacksburg Museum and Cultural Foundation

item.title: Upstairs
item.description: The upstairs galleries feature rotating exhibitions and curated displays that highlight local history, art, and cultural programs. Explore this upper-level space for changing installations and interpretive exhibits.

item.title: Visitor Info
item.description: We are open Tuesday Saturday from 10am 4pm with free admission. If you would like to schedule a group visit, please contact us so that we can be sure to accommodate you. contact us about rental needs, donations, events, exhibits or anything else that may pertain to our mission. We’re happy to help!

item.title: Calendar
item.description: Our calendar highlights exhibition openings, special programs, and public events. Check back often for new updates and seasonal activities.

item.title: On the Lawn
item.description: The lawn area hosts outdoor exhibitions, community programs, and seasonal events. This outdoor space allows visitors to engage with the museum across landscaped grounds and public displays.

item.title: Children's Gallery
item.description: The Children’s Gallery offers family-friendly exhibits, interactive displays, and programs designed to engage young visitors with history and the arts.

item.title: Featured Artist
item.description: The featured artist section celebrates local and regional creators whose work is on view in our gallery spaces. Discover their stories, creative process, and exhibition themes.
